1) tubelet detectors are a good alternative to frame-level detection for spatio-temporalaction localization; 2) our tubelet detector outperforms state-of-the-art frame-level detectors; 3) the gain of tubelet detectors over frame-level detectors is explained by both more precise localization and more accurate scores.
(1) the ACT-detector, which is a detector of tubelets, is a simple and powerful approach for spatio-temporally localizing actions in videos.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, for action localization, the frame-level is not the best level to operate on.
exploiting the temporal continuity of a video is beneficial for action detection, which is a first step towards video action recognition.
, for the task of action localization, the use of a single frame is insufficient.
